outcome: mode of delivery (vaginal vs. with episiotomy)
cohort: 124,798 women who gave birth by normal vaginal delivery or with episiotomy in three hospitals attached with Rawalpindi Medical College between 1967 and 2007.
finding: The rate of episiotomy during vaginal delivery increased over the 40-year study period, from 28.26% in 1967-1976 to 50.47% in 1996-2007.
mod_finding: 80% of nulliparous women received an episiotomy.
